lead.headline: CBDC ban becomes law as US quietly closes digital dollar path
lead.tldr: A housing bill's CBDC prohibition passed without Trump's signature, tightening the US policy divergence with Europe and China on sovereign digital money while private stablecoin and AI-agent infrastructure advances.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the US policy path on digital money is narrowing while execution infrastructure keeps expanding.

top_signals.title: Housing bill that includes a CBDC ban passed into law without Trump's signature
top_signals.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act has officially become law, incorporating a critical provision that prohibits the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). The bill passed into law without requiring a signature from President Trump.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The automatic enactment without presidential signature signals bipartisan institutional consensus against a Fed-issued digital dollar, cementing a structural headwind for CBDC-dependent business models and a tailwind for private stablecoin issuers operating in US jurisdiction.

top_signals.title: Hedera lending protocol Bonzo Lend hit for $9 million after Supra verifier accepts manipulated price update
top_signals.summary: The Hedera-based lending protocol Bonzo Lend suffered a $9 million exploit due to a manipulated price update accepted by a Supra verifier. While most funds were drained, a white hat hacker has claimed approximately $1 million and pledged to return it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Supra oracle manipulation exposes how verifier-layer centralization in purportedly decentralized infrastructure creates single points of failure that attackers are systematically probing, making oracle security a due diligence priority for any lending protocol underwriting.

top_signals.title: Stablecoins May Improve FX Access but Worsen Currency Runs: IMF
top_signals.summary: The IMF has released a paper analyzing the impact of dollar-backed stablecoins on foreign exchange markets. While they may improve FX access, the IMF warns they could accelerate currency runs by signaling dollar scarcity to the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The IMF's framing of stablecoins as FX accelerants validates the policy risk that emerging market regulators will impose capital controls or issuance restrictions, directly threatening the TAM assumptions of dollar-stablecoin growth narratives in the Global South.

top_signals.title: Robinhood to Launch AI Agent Feature For Crypto Trading
top_signals.summary: Robinhood is expanding its AI agent trading capabilities to include cryptocurrency. This feature will allow agentic accounts to execute crypto trades on behalf of users, mirroring its existing functionality for equities and options.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Robinhood's AI agent expansion into crypto normalizes autonomous execution infrastructure that will concentrate order flow and generate proprietary data moats, with implications for which venues capture retail flow as agentic trading scales.

top_signals.title: DOJ moves to dismiss charges against alleged $722M BitClub fraudster: Report29m, DOJ moves to dismiss charges against alleged $722M BitClub fraudster: ReportMatthew Goettsche was set to face trial in October for conspiracy to commit wire fraud and selling unregistered securities.
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice is reportedly moving to dismiss charges against Matthew Goettsche, who was accused of involvement in a $722 million fraud scheme related to BitClub. Goettsche had been facing charges of conspiracy to commit wire fraud and selling unregistered securities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The DOJ's reported dismissal of BitClub charges after years of prosecution raises questions about evidentiary decay in long-dated crypto fraud cases and may signal prosecutorial resource reallocation that affects enforcement risk pricing for current operators.

on_the_radar.summary: Empery Digital has sold its Bitcoin treasury holdings to finance the development of an AI data center project. This move follows pressure from a major shareholder who had previously called for the abandonment of the company's Bitcoin strategy.

on_the_radar.summary: The latest episode of Crypto Options Unplugged features Andrew Theodosiou from Talos discussing the acceleration of institutional adoption in the crypto space. The conversation focuses on the convergence of digital asset infrastructure with traditional financial systems.

linkedin_post: A lot of people saw the CBDC ban and filed it under Trump-era politics. That is the wrong read. The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act became law without his signature, which means the prohibition has institutional staying power beyond any administration. Congress embedded it in must-pass housing legislation, not standalone crypto theater. Meanwhile Robinhood is rolling AI agent execution into crypto trading, and the IMF just warned that dollar stablecoins could accelerate currency runs in emerging markets. The market is pricing in a US digital dollar as a 2020s policy option; we have underwritten that possibility on legislative trajectory and it feels mispriced to the downside. The value proposition is shifting from sovereign digital money as infrastructure to private stablecoins and agentic execution as the regulated alternative, with emerging market capital controls as the wildcard repricing event. What I'd watch: how Circle and Tether trade versus CBDC-adjacent plays in Europe and Asia, and whether any EM regulator moves first on stablecoin-specific FX restrictions. Equities got the AI agent headline; the CBDC ban did the structural volume.
